definitions.explanation: A sign displayed by stores and businesses indicating they are currently open and ready to serve customers.

examples.japanese: 「{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}」の{看板|かんばん}が{出|で}ている。
この{店|みせ}は{今|いま}{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}ですか。
{深夜|しんや}でも{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}のコンビニは{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: Convenience stores that are open even late at night are useful.

notes:
USAGE NOTE:
Commonly displayed on signs at store entrances. Often appears with {準備中|じゅんびちゅう} (preparing/closed) as the opposite side of a reversible sign.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}の{店|みせ}: store that is open
- {二十四時間|にじゅうよじかん}{営業中|えいぎょうちゅう}: open 24 hours

RELATED:
- {準備中|じゅんびちゅう}: preparing, not yet open
- {定休日|ていきゅうび}: regular day off
- {閉店|へいてん}: closing, closed
